cases.name: Actual transport boundary
cases.oracle: Local HTTP fixture verifies POST body/variables, auth header form, fixed endpoint policy, finite timeout and response size, no secret in diagnostics, redirect refusal.

cases.name: Response taxonomy
cases.oracle: 401/403 auth, 429/RATELIMITED/retry-after, 5xx, GraphQL errors with partial 200, invalid JSON, missing/null/false success and transport timeout remain distinct; mutation failures after possible send are uncertain.

cases.name: Complete pagination
cases.oracle: Multiple pages, repeated/empty/endless cursors, duplicate nodes, page failure and bounded-page ceiling never become a complete empty result.

cases.name: Identity preflight
cases.oracle: Viewer, workspace, canonical TST team UUID/key, configured project and all exact states match; wrong/missing/ambiguous IDs refuse before any mutation.

cases.name: Explicit initial Backlog
cases.oracle: Existing durable core intake creates one explicit Backlog issue with exact approved prose, project and owner; no default Triage or admission before readback.

cases.name: Exact provider prose
cases.oracle: Declared renderer applies supported presentation before approval; readback changes to title/wording/code literals/representation reject confirmation.

cases.name: Creation uncertainty
cases.oracle: Timeout/reset/crash after send preserves candidate identity and uncertain operation; recovery reads a verified UUID when supported, never retries by title or invents absence.

cases.name: Outbound status lifecycle
cases.oracle: Immediate local intent sends and reads back Todo/In Progress/delivery stages through core; actual resource/startup evidence remains required; no provider status launches a worker.

cases.name: Stale outbound authority
cases.oracle: Human hold/assignment or newer task revision before send fences stale intent. Race during request is explicit uncertainty/conflict and preserves later human authority.

cases.name: Concurrent outbound drains
cases.oracle: Two stores/connections claim one intent; expired lease is uncertain, never duplicate mutation; crash between wire readback and core confirmation is recoverable.

cases.name: Raw signed request
cases.oracle: Authentic raw-byte HMAC, UTF-8 and timestamp succeed; JSON reserialization, altered whitespace, wrong secret/signature, truncated or nonhex signature reject.

cases.name: Request bounds and ambiguity
cases.oracle: Wrong method/content type, duplicate security headers, duplicate JSON keys, malformed UTF-8/JSON, oversized body, missing/boolean/nonfinite timestamp and header/body disagreement reject safely.

cases.name: Freshness and header replay
cases.oracle: Past/future signed timestamps outside configured freshness reject. Delivery UUID is valid and nonempty; replayed body with changed unsigned delivery ID cannot cause a second domain effect.

cases.name: Durable before acknowledgement
cases.oracle: Database failure yields non-200; success commits receipt before wake/200. Wake failure leaves accepted durable pending work and is not a false application or AI ack.

cases.name: Duplicate delivery
cases.oracle: Identical fresh authenticated duplicate returns 200 once; changed payload reusing ID conflicts; concurrent duplicate receivers persist one receipt and effect.

cases.name: Scope before effects
cases.oracle: Wrong organization/webhook/team/project, unrelated issue, other principal or logical session cannot import backlog, mutate task or expose foreign content; assignment away holds owned work.

cases.name: Real inbound human application
cases.oracle: Authorized signed status/assignment change applies through core decision/policy APIs before any recovery tick; real scoped domain/lead event is emitted after application.

cases.name: Transition and evidence enforcement
cases.oracle: Illegal pairs, every review destination with missing destination evidence, delivered-issue reopen, unknown state and provider In Progress without actual worker remain conflicts; no copied policy table.

cases.name: Human actor and ordering
cases.oracle: Null/integration/untrusted actor cannot mint human authority; older/equal-conflicting updatedAt/source revision cannot replace newer hold/assignment. Exact duplicate business event across delivery IDs is harmless.

cases.name: Outbound echo and loop prevention
cases.oracle: Exact receipt-correlated provider version is an echo; same actor/status alone is insufficient. Webhook-before-response and response-before-webhook converge without extra issue/status writes or duplicate decisions.

cases.name: Pending intent supersession
cases.oracle: New human hold/status while stale outbound is pending uses reviewed shared-core supersession; blocks old worker/write, retains audit, does not silently clear provider uncertainty.

cases.name: Inbound crash recovery
cases.oracle: Failure before/after core decision/transition/readback/application receipt resumes idempotently; durable Received is never labeled Applied early.

cases.name: Loss and bounded recovery
cases.oracle: Missed webhook or reconnect reconciles registered issue IDs and uncertain operations only; recovery uses pagination where needed and never sweeps unrelated backlog.

cases.name: Separate notification facts
cases.oracle: Receipt/HTTP 200/core application/cursor/host delivery/AI ack/public report remain distinct; adapter cannot fabricate AI/user evidence.

cases.name: Restart and schema integrity
cases.oracle: Receipt journal and authority hashes survive reopen; unknown schema is refused; secrets stay outside journal and errors; fixture resources use isolated owned paths.

cases.name: Architecture and no bypass
cases.oracle: HTTP/wire client and scoped orchestration do not import legacy synchronizer, add a transition matrix, access core SQL tables or launch process/worker directly.

cases.name: Bidirectional local full path
cases.oracle: Actual loopback HTTP mock plus signed receiver exercises core intake→Backlog→Todo→worker evidence/In Progress→human hold/assignment→CLI/core/Linear convergence before reconciliation tick.

cases.name: Live fixture readiness only
cases.oracle: Concrete opt-in live plan lists viewer/TST/run project/issue/webhook allowlist, HTTPS route, signing secret storage, rollback/teardown IDs and two-user blocker; no live effects without lead review.
